info.name: KIVRO Government Agency API
info.description: Official API for government agencies to send messages to KIVRO users' digital inbox

item.name: Send Single Message

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": "{{test_user_id}}",
  "category": "Traffic Violations",
  "subject": "Traffic Violation Notice - Speeding",
  "message_body": "Dear Citizen,\n\nThis is an official notice regarding a traffic violation detected on your vehicle.\n\nViolation Details:\n- Date: January 10, 2025\n- Time: 14:35\n- Location: Maka Al Mukarama Road, Mogadishu\n- Violation: Exceeding speed limit (85 km/h in 50 km/h zone)\n\nFine Amount: $50 USD\nPayment Due: February 10, 2025\n\nYou have the right to appeal this fine within 14 days.\n\nSomalia Police Force",
  "message_type": "fine",
  "priority": "high",
  "reference_number": "SPF-2025-001234",
  "metadata": {
    "fine_amount": 50,
    "currency": "USD",
    "due_date": "2025-02-10",
    "violation_type": "speeding",
    "speed_recorded": 85,
    "speed_limit": 50,
    "location": "Maka Al Mukarama Road, Mogadishu",
    "can_appeal": true,
    "appeal_deadline": "2025-01-24"
  }
}

item.name: Send Bulk Messages

body.raw:
{
  "user_ids": [
    "{{test_user_id}}"
  ],
  "category": "General Notices",
  "subject": "Community Safety Alert",
  "message_body": "Dear Residents,

Please be advised of increased security patrols in your area this week due to recent security concerns.

Patrol Schedule:
- Monday to Friday: 6:00 PM - 6:00 AM
- Saturday to Sunday: 24-hour patrols

Please report any suspicious activities to our emergency hotline: +252-1-234567

Stay safe and vigilant.

Somalia Police Force",
  "message_type": "alert",
  "priority": "urgent",
  "reference_number_prefix": "ALERT-2025"
}
